*Softly*… *Goodnight, my love. Sleep tight.* 🌙✨"  

*(A gentle hum fades into silence, as the room grows warm and safe.)*

*Softly*… *Goodnight, my love. Sleep tight.* 🌙✨"  

*(A gentle hum fades into silence, as the room grows warm and safe.)*
